pick.name: Windows Snap Layouts + PowerToys (FancyZones + Workspaces)
pick.what: Native snapping plus PowerToys zones and one-click 'Workspaces' that launch apps (VS Code, Terminal, browsers with URLs) into saved positions
pick.why: Built-in/Microsoft-signed, free, part of PowerToys, and Workspaces gives per-project desktops with CLI args

alts.name: GlazeWM
alts.what: i3-style tiling window manager for Windows
alts.why: Best free tiling WM if you want keyboard-only tiling; development slowed (last release 2026-03-21)

alts.name: komorebi
alts.why: Most powerful tiler, but its licence forbids any commercial/work use without a paid individual commercial licence
alts.free_limits: Free for non-commercial only; paid Individual Commercial Use License (price not on README)

candidates.name: komorebi
candidates.verdict: Commercial use not allowed without paid licence

decision: Native Snap plus PowerToys Workspaces/FancyZones covers a solo founder's 'one desktop per project' need with zero licence risk. Pick GlazeWM only if you want true tiling; avoid komorebi for work unless you buy its commercial licence.

verify.note: PowerToys pick fine. komorebi alt licence confirmed: Komorebi License 2.0.0 (PolyForm Strict fork) forbids any commercial use incl. using it at work; a paid Individual Commercial Use License exists (price on lgug2z.com, not the README).
